About Zahnklar

Understanding makes a difference.

I’m Benedict Lersch, a dentist and the founder of Zahnklar. I make dentistry visual so you can understand what happens and find the words for your questions at your next appointment. For children and dental teams, that also means stories, explanation sheets and practical resources.
